podcast.title: Connection to John Dolphin
podcast.body: John Dolphin, owner of Dolphins of Hollywood, was mentioned in previous podcast episodes concerning Jean and Eunice, highlighting his significant role in their success. "We've talked about Dolphin before, in the episodes on Jean and Eunice and the Penguins."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Jamaican Taste Preference (1960s)
podcast.body: Jamaican audiences in the early 1960s continued to prefer the R&B sound of artists like Jean and Eunice, in contrast to changing American tastes for rock and pop. "Jamaican audiences wanted Louis Jordan, Fat Storner and Jean and Eunice, but the Americans wanted Elvis and Gerrilly Lewis and Bobby Daring."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Shirley and Lee Imitators
podcast.body: Jean and Eunice were among the artists who imitated the sound and style of New Orleans R&B duo Shirley and Lee. "spawned a host of emitators, including Jean and Eunice and Mickey and Sylvia."
